name: slide-metadata
body: Per-slide metadata derived at render time from the slide's position (a derived value, distinct from authored frontmatter): number — the slide's position label, a STRING formed from its `(number, letter)` position (domain.value.slide-position): the number with the lower-cased letter appended for a vertical slide and no letter for a horizontal slide (e.g. `1`, `1a`, `2`, `5`) — and total — the number of slide files in the deck, an integer. Exposed to layouts and section templates under the reserved `slide` context (template-context). Derived from domain.value.slide-position.
